newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-DRAUDIMAS Q1 NET PROFIT UP TO 2.09 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-DRAUDIMAS Q1 NET PROFIT UP TO 2.09 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's biggest insurance company, Lietuvos Draudimas, said on Tuesday that net profit in the first quarter of 1997 advanced to 2.09 million litas from 230,000 litas in the same period last year.
Lietuvos Draudimas (Lithuanian Insurance) is a 70 percent state-owned company which accounts for around 58 percent of the country's insurance market.

"The company's insurance premiums also advanced to 31.9 million litas during the three month period compared to 26.7 million litas in the first quarter of 1996," Roma Bruzgiene, the finance director of the company, told Reuters.
The company has reported earlier that its net profit in 1996 was 19.2 million litas.
"For the second quarter we plan insurance premium growth over the first three months of the year since the number of clients and insurance sums are growing," Bruzgiene said.
The company's share capital stands at four million litas.
"The shareholders of the company decided in January to boost share capital by 10 million litas from the reserves but the new share issue has not been registered so far," Bruzgiene said.
